name: EMA
summary: An Expert Advisor based on Exponential Moving Average (EMA) crossover signals to identify trend direction and generate trade entries. It opens buy positions when a fast EMA crosses above a slow EMA and sell positions on the reverse crossover, following the established trend. The EA is a classic trend-following system that relies on moving average dynamics to capture directional market moves.
summary_zh: 基于指数移动平均线(EMA)交叉信号的趋势跟踪EA，通过快速EMA上穿慢速EMA开多单，反之开空单。该EA是经典的趋势跟踪系统，依赖均线动能捕捉方向性行情。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于双EMA交叉系统，利用快速EMA与慢速EMA的黄金交叉和死亡交叉来判断趋势方向。入场条件为快速EMA向上穿越慢速EMA时开多单，快速EMA向下穿越慢速EMA时开空单，这是典型的均线交叉趋势跟踪入场逻辑。出场条件通常依赖于反向交叉信号平仓，即持有多单时出现死叉平多，持有空单时出现金叉平空。仓位管理方面，该EA使用固定手数进行交易，缺乏基于账户余额或波动率的动态仓位调整机制。资金管理层面，该EA可能缺少止损止盈设置或仅有基础的风控措施，存在单笔亏损不可控的风险。整体策略简单直观，但在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a dual EMA crossover system, using golden cross and death cross of a fast and slow EMA to determine trend direction. Entry conditions trigger a buy when the fast EMA crosses above the slow EMA, and a sell when the fast EMA crosses below the slow EMA, which is a classic moving average crossover trend-following entry logic. Exit conditions typically rely on the reverse crossover signal to close positions - closing longs on a death cross and closing shorts on a golden cross. Position sizing uses fixed lot sizes without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or market volatility, which limits adaptability to changing market conditions. Money management may lack stop-loss and take-profit configurations or only have basic risk controls, creating potential for uncontrolled single-trade losses. The overall strategy is straightforward but prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging or choppy markets.

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, limits max loss per trade

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, locks profit target per trade

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description_en: Magic number for closing, 0 for all positions

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和验证
趋势行情中能有效捕捉中线波段利润
EMA相比SMA对价格变化响应更快，信号滞后性较小
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic that is easy to understand and backtest
Effectively captures medium-term swing profits during trending markets
EMA responds faster to price changes than SMA, reducing signal lag
cons: 震荡行情中频繁产生虚假交叉信号导致连续亏损
缺少动态仓位管理和风险控制机制，固定手数无法适应市场波动
均线交叉属于滞后指标，入场时趋势已有一定幅度走完
缺乏市场状态过滤器，无法区分趋势市和震荡市
cons_en: Frequent false crossover signals in ranging markets lead to consecutive losses
Lacks dynamic position sizing and risk management; fixed lots cannot adapt to market volatility
Moving average crossovers are lagging indicators, entering after the trend has already moved significantly
No market regime filter to distinguish between trending and ranging conditions
improvements: 增加ATR或ADX等趋势强度过滤器，在震荡市中减少无效交易
引入动态仓位管理，根据账户余额和波动率调整手数
加入止损止盈机制和移动止盈功能，保护已有利润
improvements_en: Add ATR or ADX trend strength filters to reduce invalid trades in ranging markets
Introduce dynamic position sizing based on account equity and market volatility
Implement stop-loss/take-profit mechanisms and trailing stop functionality to protect profits

risk_points: 震荡市中均线交叉信号频繁失效导致连续止损
固定手数缺乏风控弹性，极端行情下单笔亏损可能过大
止损止盈参数默认为0可能导致无限亏损风险
risk_points_en: Frequent false signals in ranging markets cause consecutive stop-losses
Fixed lot sizing lacks risk control flexibility; single-trade losses can be excessive in extreme markets
Default stop-loss and take-profit of zero may expose unlimited loss risk
